trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL. Direct shell fetching of https://zbmath.org/7949050 returned blocked_or_challenged: HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge. The zbMATH API resolved document ID 7949050 to the book chapter titled Open problems, DOI 10.1093/oso/9780198841319.003.0023, pages 353-382 in The Disc Embedding Theorem.

Bounded recovery followed the DOI and checked identifier-specific metadata via Crossref and OpenAlex. Crossref confirmed the same DOI and exposed the Oxford Academic landing page and a chapter-PDF URL, but the Oxford Academic landing page and chapter-PDF URL returned blocked_or_challenged or access-only pages rather than readable full text. OpenAlex reported open_access.is_oa=false, oa_status=closed, no best_oa_location, no oa_url, and any_repository_has_fulltext=false.

Exact-work search attempts used the DOI, the exact title with the authors, and the exact title plus key phrases from the resolver summary. Candidate pages inspected or identified were Oxford Academic, MPG.PuRe, Crossref/OpenAlex metadata, bibliographic references, and a non-source-authorized full-book mirror. Oxford Academic and MPG.PuRe did not provide freely readable full text, metadata APIs were not used as technical source text, and the mirror was rejected as not a source-authorized readable artifact. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements could be verified.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-7949050.json and mirrored it to outputs/latest.json.
